description: Source code for the IPSO Timer object implementation in Zephyr OS, including resource definitions, instance management, and timer control functions.

methods.name: get_timer_index
methods.description: Finds the index of a timer instance by object instance ID.

methods.name: start_timer
methods.description: Starts a timer if conditions are met, scheduling work accordingly.

methods.name: stop_timer
methods.description: Stops a timer and cancels scheduled work.

methods.name: remaining_time_read_cb
methods.description: Reads the remaining time for a timer instance.

methods.name: cumulative_time_read_cb
methods.description: Reads the cumulative active time of a timer instance.

methods.name: cumulative_time_post_write_cb
methods.description: Resets the cumulative time after write.

methods.name: timer_work_cb
methods.description: Callback for timer work execution, stops the timer.

methods.name: timer_trigger_cb
methods.description: Callback to trigger a timer start.

methods.name: timer_inst_create
methods.description: Creates a new timer instance with default values and resource initialization.

methods.name: ipso_timer_init
methods.description: Initializes the IPSO Timer object and registers it.
